title: Extend sdd decompose: structured task labels with CON-IDs
description: Extend the output of `sdd decompose SPEC-XXXX` to produce a structured JSON array of task objects — each with `id`, `label`, and `con_ids[]` — alongside the existing human-readable plan. This is the prerequisite for contract filtering (FR-07) and sub-agent context isolation (FR-02).

title: Extend TokenRecord schema: add task_id and task_label fields
description: Add optional `task_id: str | None` and `task_label: str | None` fields to the `TokenRecord` dataclass in `estimation.py`. Backwards-compatible: existing entries without these fields remain valid. Fulfils CON-0121.

title: Define TokenExtractor interface (Strategy Pattern)
description: Create an abstract `TokenExtractor` base class in a new `token_extractor.py` module with a single method `extract(usage: Any) -> TokenRecord`. No concrete implementation here — only the interface contract, enabling future swappable extractors (FR-03).

title: Implement ClaudeSDKTokenExtractor
description: Concrete `TokenExtractor` implementation for the Claude Agent SDK `usage` object. Reads `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, and `cache_read_tokens` from the SDK response and maps them onto a `TokenRecord`. Registers as the default extractor when provider is Claude (FR-03).

title: Implement SubAgentTokenTrackingDecorator
description: Decorator (Decorator Pattern) that wraps a Claude Agent SDK sub-agent call. Before the call: opens a token-tracking context. After the call: invokes `TokenExtractor.extract(usage)` to produce a `TokenRecord` with `task_id` and `task_label`, then persists it to `token-history`. Token tracking is kept orthogonal to task logic (FR-03, FR-04).

title: Implement contract filtering by task CON-IDs
description: Pure function `filter_contracts(task_con_ids: list[str], all_contracts: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, Path]` that returns only the contract file paths referenced in a task's `con_ids[]`. Used to build the isolated context for each sub-agent (FR-02, FR-07).

title: New CLI command sdd implement: provider guard and orchestration skeleton
description: Add `sdd implement SPEC-XXXX` as a new CLI entry point. Detect the active provider; if not Claude, set a `fallback` flag. Wire the sub-agent loop skeleton: iterate over decompose task list, call decorated sub-agent spawn (or fallback), collect results. Print `[Fallback: Single-Context-Mode]` when fallback is active (FR-08, FR-09).

title: Sub-agent spawning with isolated context per task
description: Inside `sdd implement`, for each decompose task: build an isolated prompt containing only the spec text, filtered contracts (`filter_contracts`), and the task's test stubs. Spawn a Claude Agent SDK sub-agent with this context and no cross-task conversation history. Return the agent result and `usage` object to the decorator (FR-01, FR-02).

title: Retry logic: 1 retry on sub-agent failure, then escalate
description: After a sub-agent raises an error or returns a failure result, schedule exactly one retry with the same isolated context. Track attempt count (max 2). If the retry also fails, transition the orchestrator to a `halted` state and record the failed task for reporting. No further tasks are started after a double failure (FR-06).

title: Orchestrator error report on sub-agent double-failure
description: When the orchestrator enters `halted` state, generate and print a structured failure report: `task_id`, `task_label`, error message, attempt count. Ensure the loop exits immediately — subsequent tasks must not be started. No silent failure (FR-06).

title: Single-Context-Mode fallback for non-Claude providers
description: When `fallback` flag is set in `sdd implement`, skip sub-agent spawning entirely and execute the existing single-context TDD loop inline. Output must contain `[Fallback: Single-Context-Mode]` at the start. Token tracking in this path remains unchanged (FR-09).

title: calibrate command: per-task token breakdown display
description: Extend `sdd calibrate SPEC-XXXX` to query `token-history` for entries that carry `task_id`. If present, render a per-task breakdown table (task_id, task_label, input, output, cache_read) below the existing overall total. Table is omitted if no task-granular entries exist (FR-05).

title: Update sdd-implement skill: delegate implementation step to sdd implement CLI
description: Rewrite step 3 of the `sdd-implement` skill to call `sdd implement SPEC-XXXX` instead of executing the TDD loop inline. The skill no longer owns task execution; it only orchestrates the CLI call and surfaces results to the user (FR-08).

title: Unit test TST-0140: token aggregation sum validation
description: Test that the sum of `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, and `cache_read_tokens` across all per-task `TokenRecord` entries for a spec equals the overall session total stored in `token-history`. Uses mocked sub-agent responses with fixed `usage` values.

title: Unit test TST-0141: fallback single-context mode activation
description: Test that when the active provider is not Claude, `sdd implement` sets the fallback flag, skips sub-agent spawning, runs the single-context loop, and includes `[Fallback: Single-Context-Mode]` in stdout. No Claude Agent SDK calls should occur.

title: Contract test TST-0142: token-history schema task_id read/write
description: Write a `TokenRecord` with `task_id` and `task_label` to `token-history`, then read it back and assert field-level equality. Also assert that a `TokenRecord` without these fields is still accepted (backwards compatibility). Validates CON-0121.

title: Contract test TST-0143: sub-agent error propagation halts orchestrator
description: Simulate a sub-agent that fails on both the initial attempt and the retry. Assert that the orchestrator halts after the double failure, emits a failure report containing the failing `task_id`, and does not start any subsequent tasks. Validates CON-0122 and FR-06.
